lame.min.js is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), an MP3 encoder written in
JavaScript, taken unmodified from the npm package. It is licensed under the GNU LGPL 3.0
(see LAME-LICENSE.txt). It is kept as its own file so it can be replaced by another build
of the same library. It is only loaded by the recording tool, to turn a recording into an MP3.
